rationale: A is more useful for choosing among live alternatives because it defines decision-relevant KPIs, compares all options (including hybrids), quantifies tradeoffs, and handles uncertainty explicitly with assumptions and intervals. B gives strong practical sequencing advice and clearer execution detail, but it offers less rigorous discrimination across options and almost no quantitative support. Since the task is to decide the strongest launch strategy, A better supports a careful decision-maker, even though B is slightly more operational.
